# Tabler UI 1.4.0

Vendored compiled assets from the MIT-licensed Tabler project:

- https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@tabler/core@1.4.0/dist/css/tabler.min.css
- https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@tabler/core@1.4.0/dist/js/tabler.min.js
- License: https://github.com/tabler/tabler/blob/dev/LICENSE (included as `LICENSE`)
- Documentation: https://docs.tabler.io/ui/

Tabler includes Bootstrap components; do not add another Bootstrap JavaScript
bundle. The application uses system fonts and needs no CDN or package install.
The upstream compiled headers retain their dependency notices.
